title: The Payex Payment Gateway for Woocommerce WordPress plugin through 1.2.10 does not properly verify the authenticity of…
description: The Payex Payment Gateway for Woocommerce WordPress plugin versions through 1.2.10 fails to properly verify the authenticity of incoming payment notifications. This is due to reliance on a validation secret that is empty by default, which allows unauthenticated attackers to forge payment confirmations and mark orders as paid without authorization.
